_help: Copy this file to config.json before running, then edit the copy.
IMPORTANT: 'tokenEnvVar' is the NAME of an environment variable, not the token.
Example: keep "tokenEnvVar": "ME_ADAUDIT_TOKEN" here, and before running do:
To put the token in this file instead, add a "token": "<token>" field to the
product and leave tokenEnvVar alone. That stores a secret on disk, so config.json
Set 'baseUrl' of every product to your real server, or delete the products you do
not use - a leftover placeholder host just reports as unreachable.
'latestVersion' and 'latestBuild' ship EMPTY on purpose: they are the reference you
compare against, and only you know which release your organisation treats as
current. Leave them empty to just report the installed version, or fill them in
from the product's release-notes page to get an up-to-date / update-available
status. Find the installed values under Help > About in the product console.
Lines starting with _ are ignored by the script.
